caption: The drawing depicts a marionette puppet suspended by multiple black strings, each attached to its head, arms, and legs. The puppet has a large, exaggerated head with black hair, bushy eyebrows, and a prominent nose and chin, and its cheeks are distinctly rosy. It is wearing a gold helmet with a silver jagged extension at the top. The puppet is dressed in a bright red outfit with yellow decorative lines on the chest, black scar-like marks on the clothes, and a cape lined with light blue on the inside. Its right hand holds a curved dagger with a grey blade and brown handle. The puppet's legs are also red with black crisscrossing straps, and it is wearing black shoes. The background is plain and light beige, and the signature "Elmer Weiss" is written in black in the bottom left corner of the drawing.
title: Marionette: "King Saul"
